Wedding Celebrations

Four Days of Light

Friday · 5 March 2027 · 6:00 PM

Nichayathartham

The engagement — rings exchanged and the wedding formally announced before the elders and the sacred fire.

Venue: Sri Lakshmi Kalyana Mandapam, Mylapore

Saturday · 6 March 2027 · 10:00 AM

Manjal & Haldi

Turmeric, sandalwood and laughter — the bride and groom are blessed and brightened for the big day.

Venue: Sri Lakshmi Kalyana Mandapam, Mylapore

Sunday · 7 March 2027 · Muhurtham 9:30 AM

The Wedding — Muhurtham

As the nadaswaram rises and the lamps burn bright, Karthik ties the sacred thaali around Lakshmi at the auspicious hour of 9:30 AM, followed by a traditional sadhya lunch for all guests.

Venue: Sri Lakshmi Kalyana Mandapam, Luz Church Road, Mylapore, Chennai

Monday · 8 March 2027 · 6:30 PM

Reception & Dinner

An evening of blessings, photographs and a grand dinner as the newlyweds meet every guest.

Venue: Sri Lakshmi Kalyana Mandapam, Mylapore

Every Evening · From 5 March

Deepam Lighting

At sunset each day, a hundred brass lamps are lit at the mandapam entrance — join us in lighting one for the couple.
